destination.title: Quintessence and related dynamical dark-energy questions
destination.question: How do specified quintessence and related dark-energy models evolve, acquire their potentials and initial conditions, and confront observations and theoretical consistency tests?
destination.summary: No original verbal parent scope was supplied, so the numerical grouping cannot be endorsed as an established scientific organization. The supplied contrasts support distinguishable questions about potential protection, cosmological preparation, background specification, observational inference and monomial axion relations. Existing child questions provide broader access, with their original limits retained.

systems: Source-specified canonical, interacting and noncanonical quintessence
Axion, modulus, radion and other microscopic candidates
Particle and dark sectors coupled to quintessence
Thermal, modified-gravity and generalized cosmologies as explicitly distinguished comparisons
targets: Background evolution, initial conditions and reconstruction
Source-dated observational discrimination and model comparison
Coupling effects, gravity tests, perturbations and other signals
Duration and endpoints of acceleration where the supporting question is admitted
regimes: Source-specific early, matter-era, late-time and future evolution
Tracking, thawing, scaling and interaction-supported histories
Distinct compactification, gravitational and kinetic frameworks
assumptions: Kinetic terms, matter interactions, dimensionality, geometry and boundary conditions remain source-specific.
Swampland and other proposed restrictions are conditional hypotheses or objects of criticism.
A viable background does not establish radiative protection, microscopic control or acceptable perturbations.
Attributed child coverage does not constitute a parent rereading of the descendants.
conventions: Keep scalar, effective dark-energy and fitted equations of state distinct.
Preserve field normalization, curvature signs and physical versus conformal expansion rates.
Potential reconstruction need not determine an absolute field origin.
Use supplied version dates rather than infer dates from identifiers.
includes: Methodological settings without an independently established question identity
Alternate homes for thermal acceleration, generalized cosmologies and Quintom bounces
Pending construction and future-evolution questions as explicitly unadmitted comparison context
excludes: A universal canonical, uncoupled, four-dimensional or Swampland premise
Current observational validation from archived results
A universal monomial relation outside the supplied rolling regime
Automatic admission of child scopes requiring adjudication
Equivalence inferred from numerical ancestry, shared terminology or common overview membership
Quintom bouncing or dynamical uplifting treated as established quintessence realizations

sources.title: Dark Energy in the Swampland

evidence.text: How tightly do then-current observations and prospective dark-energy surveys constrain quintessence satisfying the string Swampland criteria, and could observations distinguish surviving models from a cosmological constant?

sources.title: Constraints on quintessence scalar field models using cosmological observations

evidence.text: Can selected quintessence potentials explain late cosmic acceleration, have their shape parameters constrained by cosmological observations, relieve the H0 tension, and compete statistically with ΛCDM?

sources.title: Quintessence, flat potential and string / M theory axion

evidence.text: Can quintessence retain an extremely flat potential despite matter and quantum-gravity effects, and can heterotic M-theory or Type I axions realize it with viable cosmological initial conditions?

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: The model couples the modulus controlling a runaway direction to a dynamical hidden matter sector that also participates in vacuum uplifting. It permits the cosmological role of the uplifting field to be studied instead of replacing that field by a fixed positive contribution.

sources.title: Time variation of fundamental couplings and dynamical dark energy

evidence.text: How can correlated variations of fundamental couplings, cosmological scalar dynamics and weak equivalence principle tests constrain one another, and which illustrative quintessence histories accommodate the historical variation claims and bounds?

sources.title: Spherical collapse in quintessence models with zero speed of sound

evidence.text: How does single-scalar quintessence with negligible sound speed alter spherical collapse, the linear collapse threshold and halo abundance, including the quintessence contribution to the gravitational mass of virialized objects?

sources.title: Natural Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a geometric scalar in a string compactification provide quintessence with a radiatively stable mass near 10^-33 eV and sufficiently weak Standard Model couplings, and produce viable late-time evolution with or without dark matter interactions?

sources.title: Quintessence: A Review

evidence.text: How do canonical quintessence models evolve, which analytic descriptions of their equation of state and matter growth are useful observationally, and what particle-physics mechanisms can protect the required tiny scalar mass?

sources.title: Interacting quintessence from a variational approach Part II: derivative couplings

evidence.text: Can a variational coupling linear in the scalar-field gradient produce covariant interacting quintessence models with matter-dominated intermediate evolution, late acceleration, and possible phantom-barrier crossing?

sources.title: Beta function quintessence cosmological parameters and fundamental constants – I. Power and inverse power law dark energy potentials

evidence.text: Can a beta function chosen to approximate a quintessence potential provide useful analytic predictions in the observable scale factor, and help distinguish dynamical dark energy from a cosmological constant?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can a quintessence gradient grow with the electroweak potential away from the observed Higgs vacuum while avoiding direct couplings to other visible matter?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional Standard Model–quintessence theory obey an order-one scalar-potential gradient bound while satisfying limits on fifth forces and varying Standard Model parameters? Can a controlled string construction realize the required selective couplings?

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: Sequestering tests whether a special gravitational geometry can prevent hidden-sector supersymmetry breaking from giving quintessence a large mass, without imposing the imaginary-field shift symmetry used in the first construction.

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: What protects the small quintessence potential and gradient from quantum corrections, and can a conjectural lower gradient bound explain their tuning?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the reported string construction supply an exponential slope small enough for quintessence? Its small-slope regime requires at least 11542 internal dimensions.

sources.title: The Swampland, Quintessence and the Vacuum Energy

evidence.text: Can cosmological variation of particle masses or couplings coexist with a quintessence potential of dark-energy size once quantum vacuum-energy corrections are included?

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How can general nonderivative interactions between quintessence and the Standard Model be parametrized while keeping the gravitational frame and scalar normalization explicit?

sources.title: Strongly Coupled Quintessence

evidence.text: Can strongly coupled flux-monodromy effective theories realize technically natural quintessence with sufficiently small potential slope, controlled quantum corrections and observable departures from a cosmological constant?

sources.title: Isocurvature Perturbations of Dark Energy and Dark Matter from the Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quintessence retain the small mass required for inflationary fluctuations despite gravitational, inflaton, and thermal couplings?

sources.title: The swampland conjecture and the Higgs expectation value

evidence.text: Can the Higgs mass and quartic terms track a quintessence-dependent vacuum-energy counterterm closely enough to retain small energy as the field evolves?

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can the physical electroweak theta angle become a quintessence field? The proposal replaces the fixed angle by a/f_a and restricts other interactions so that electroweak instantons can set the small potential amplitude.

sources.title: Constraints on field flows of quintessence dark energy

evidence.text: Can physically motivated restrictions on matter-era scalar evolution make potential parameters and initial conditions inferable from expansion data, and distinguish thawing from freezing quintessence?

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Does the protection survive when quintessence itself propagates in a loop? A linear matter potential makes that failure accessible at one loop, while the source places the analogous massive quadratic-matter corrections at two loops.

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Can low-scale new physics, a persistent cancellation, or environmental screening reconcile a radiatively stable quintessence slope with gravity tests? The paper leaves these as open routes after identifying two obstacles.

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Can coupling quintessence only to hidden matter avoid visible fifth forces without losing the natural potential–slope relation? The visible Standard Model remains a spectator for the slope but contributes to the total vacuum energy.

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Does a small quintessence vacuum energy automatically imply a sufficiently small slope after radiative corrections, or must the two quantities be adjusted independently? The target also includes consistency with fifth-force observations.

sources.title: Evolution of Dark Energy Perturbations for Slotheon Field and Power Spectrum

evidence.text: How do background evolution, linear dark-energy and matter perturbations, and the matter power spectrum behave for thawing Slotheon dark energy, relative to the paper's canonical-quintessence and ΛCDM calculations?

sources.title: Leaving the Swampland: Non-geometric fluxes and the Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an inverse-volume runaway serve as quintessence while suppressing changes in matter couplings? The source offers a qualitative possibility without calculating cosmological dynamics or fifth-force observables.

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: How much can canonical exponential quintessence move over cosmological time, and can that motion generate the parameter changes required by the particle-physics examples?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: Can quintessence move during radiation domination while contributing only a small fraction of the cosmic density?

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: Freeze local slopes and neglect expansion during conversion from stationary fields. Solve the conserved-energy system and use its limiting kinetic shares to initialize dilution. The reconstructed solution retains the velocity signs and the initial-energy factor in its hyperbolic-function time scale.

sources.title: Time variation of fundamental couplings and dynamical dark energy

evidence.text: Expand coupling functions as Δln Gk ≈ βk Δϕ. Differentiate atomic masses to obtain scalar charges and η ≈ 2λs(λb−λc), retaining isospin, Coulomb binding and strong nuclear surface contributions.

sources.title: Spherical collapse in quintessence models with zero speed of sound

evidence.text: Numerically solve coupled background, linear-growth and top-hat equations. Obtain matter spectra with CAMB using historical WMAP5 parameters apart from w. Estimate abundance with Press–Schechter ratios multiplying a smooth-quintessence Sheth–Tormen mass function.

sources.title: Natural Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Use an autonomous phase-plane system, analytical instantaneous fixed points, and numerical trajectories to study the poly-instanton plateau and loop-dominated region separately and in the full potential.

sources.title: Quintessence: A Review

evidence.text: For linear matter growth, expand w and the growth index in Ωφ, approximate the index as nearly constant, integrate the density contrast, and express the result as f(z)σ8(z) for comparison with redshift-space distortions.

sources.title: Interacting quintessence from a variational approach Part II: derivative couplings

evidence.text: For Model B, derive linear scalar perturbation equations in Newtonian gauge and Fourier space. This supplies equations and qualitative comments rather than a complete perturbation evolution or stability analysis.

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence from monodromic axion dark energy

evidence.text: Do the decay-constant and equation-of-state relations survive replacing a linear monodromy potential with a broader monomial potential?

sources.title: Reconstructing Quintessence

evidence.text: Canonical quintessence replaces a constant dark-energy density with a minimally coupled scalar whose kinetic and potential energies determine cosmic expansion. A potential alone does not determine the history; scalar boundary conditions are also needed.

destination.title: Compactification vacua, effective theories and stability
destination.question: How do geometry, sources, gaugings and supersymmetry determine compactification vacua, their effective descriptions and spectra, and the control, decay or protection mechanisms available under specified assumptions?
destination.summary: Construction, geometric hierarchies, spectral completeness and stability are connected but distinct targets. Bubble existence, topological permission and dynamical suppression require separate tests. Holographic and cosmological applications retain their additional assumptions. Numerical child batches provide provenance rather than mandatory public branches.

Kaluza–Klein compactifications and gravitational bubble models

Perturbative stability and specified nonperturbative channels

Qualified uplift, cosmological and brane applications

sources.title: The $ \mathcal{N}>2 $ supersymmetric AdS vacua in maximal supergravity

evidence.text: Which AdS vacua of four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity preserve N>2 supersymmetries, which gaugings support them, and what mass spectra and AdS supermultiplets realize their partial supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Brane-jet stability of non-supersymmetric AdS vacua

evidence.text: Do non-supersymmetric AdS vacua of dyonic ISO(7) maximal supergravity that are perturbatively stable within D = 4 develop brane-jet instabilities after uplift to massive IIA, or decay through domain walls?

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Does uplifting a nonperturbatively stabilized type-IIB AdS vacuum leave a sufficiently broad barrier against volume decompactification?

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can a perturbatively stabilized flux compactification nevertheless decay through a smooth bubble of nothing, and what charged source permits the compact cycle to disappear without a flux singularity?

sources.title: Decay of flux vacua to nothing

evidence.text: Can magnetic-flux compactifications to four dimensions decay through a smooth charged bubble of nothing in which the entire internal S² degenerates, including compactifications with AdS, Minkowski and de Sitter large dimensions?

sources.title: Supersymmetric AdS vacua and separation of scales

evidence.text: Do independently adjustable geometric parameters in supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS₄×S²(B₄) vacua permit scale separation after flux quantisation, and what can curvature ratios and a test-scalar KK spectrum establish?

sources.title: Slow-Roll Inflation in Non-geometric Flux Compactification

evidence.text: Which constrained integer-flux configurations yield stable non-supersymmetric dS or AdS extrema in an isotropic type IIB non-geometric model, and do the reported dS examples admit small-field, multi-field slow-roll conditions?

sources.title: More stable de Sitter vacua from S-dual nongeometric fluxes

evidence.text: Can S-dual nongeometric P-fluxes and torus anisotropy produce further stable dS/AdS candidates, remove instabilities hidden by isotropic truncations, and change the moduli hierarchies relevant to small-field inflation?

sources.title: Stability, Tunneling and Flux Changing de Sitter Transitions in the Large Volume String Scenario

evidence.text: Are non-supersymmetric LVS AdS minima nonperturbatively stable within effective field theory, and how do uplifted dS vacua decay through flux-changing brane nucleation and tunneling to decompactification?

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation and Non-Supersymmetric Vacua

evidence.text: Can heterotic geometric moduli and the dilaton be stabilized perturbatively in finite-coupling, nonsupersymmetric vacua, and can the resulting AdS minima be lifted to dS?

sources.title: Remarks on scale separation in flux vacua

evidence.text: Can Maldacena–Nuñez-type restrictions on Minkowski and de Sitter flux vacua also obstruct AdS vacua whose KK masses are parametrically above the cosmological curvature scale? What would this imply for classical Romans-mass smoothing of O6 singularities?

sources.title: Revisiting constraints on uplifts to de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can brane-based uplifts of type IIB AdS vacua satisfy both the integrated Gibbons–Maldacena–Nuñez constraint and the constraint reproducing four-dimensional Einstein equations, rather than only giving a positive four-dimensional effective potential?

sources.title: New Kaluza-Klein instantons and the decay of AdS vacua

evidence.text: Can a higher-dimensional sphere collapse smoothly in a flux-supported compactification, producing a finite-action bubble-of-nothing instanton that destabilizes otherwise perturbatively stable non-supersymmetric AdS vacua?

sources.title: A swamp of non-SUSY vacua

evidence.text: Do known massive-IIA non-supersymmetric AdS vacua that appear stable in closed-string truncations become unstable after including open-string degrees of freedom on their supporting D6-branes?

sources.title: On the KKLT Goldstino

evidence.text: Does a consistent truncation admitting conifold deformation introduce additional UV supersymmetry-breaking modes or modify the holographic Ward-identity diagnosis of a goldstino?

sources.title: A Quantum Check of Non-Supersymmetric AdS/dCFT

evidence.text: Can a planar one-loop field-theory calculation reproduce the supergravity prediction for chiral-primary one-point functions in the flux-stabilized, completely non-supersymmetric D3-D7 AdS/dCFT setup?

sources.title: Modular symmetries and the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Do the nonsupersymmetric AdS local minima admit a nonperturbative decay compatible with the conjecture excluding stable nonsupersymmetric AdS vacua?

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Could a flat family through a supersymmetric AdS vacuum provide stable nonsupersymmetric AdS examples? The source considers this mechanism in relation to the cited instability conjecture.

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Can D8 interface conditions admit supersymmetry-breaking families, and what nonsupersymmetric solutions exist away from supersymmetric branches? Both questions remain open in this work.

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS7 compactification with fixed flux and localized pole sources have continuous supersymmetry-breaking directions? The configurations have SO(3)-invariant profiles on an internal S3 and are studied in classical supergravity.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Can positive energy uplift a quantum-stabilized AdS vacuum while preserving stabilization? The relevant starting data include supersymmetry, nonzero superpotential, and whether stabilization uses KKLT, LVS, or more elaborate nonperturbative effects.

sources.title: ${\mathcal{N}=(8,0)}$ AdS vacua of three-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which half-maximal three-dimensional gauged supergravities admit fully supersymmetric chiral N=(8,0) AdS3 vacua for n≤8 matter multiplets, and what are their embedding tensors, gauge groups, fluctuation spectra and possible embeddings into maximal supergravity?

sources.title: Brane annihilation in non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Do non-supersymmetric string AdS flux vacua decay nonperturbatively toward smaller flux, and can vacuum bubbles, probe dynamics, and near-horizon geometries support a microscopic brane-annihilation interpretation?

sources.title: Brane nucleation instabilities in non-AdS/non-CFT

evidence.text: Does a supersymmetry- and conformal-symmetry-breaking deformation of finite-density Klebanov–Witten theory retain low-temperature brane nucleation instabilities, and what bearing might these have on the proposed absence of disordered zero-temperature holographic phases?

sources.title: Quantum Log-Corrections to Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: How do modulus and KK scales behave in a type IIA AdS flux family with a dilute-flux limit?

sources.title: On scale separation in type II AdS flux vacua

evidence.text: Do apparent violations of AdS/KK scale separation and the strong AdS distance conjecture in selected type II flux EFTs survive when the internal geometry, its flux-dependent normalization, and the lightest KK directions are included?

sources.title: On AdS$_{7}$ stability

evidence.text: Are the known non-supersymmetric sisters of supersymmetric type-IIA AdS7 vacua perturbatively or nonperturbatively unstable, and can these families exhibit separation between AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales?

sources.title: Brane-Jet Instabilities

evidence.text: Can localized fundamental-brane probes expose decay channels of nonsupersymmetric AdS vacua that are invisible within gauged maximal supergravity, especially the SO(3)×SO(3)-invariant AdS4 vacuum?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does supersymmetry force a KK tower to track AdS curvature in every small-cosmological-constant limit? The paper tests this conjectural restriction using the localized continuation of DGKT vacua.

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does the KK tower decouple from AdS curvature as the cosmological constant approaches zero? The diagnostic compares a squared KK mass with curvature, normalized consistently in the lower-dimensional theory.

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Preserve the axion isometry during stabilization, gauge it with magnetic D7 flux, and use the positive D-term for uplift. The isometry is an input condition, so the construction cannot be transferred unchanged to a shift-breaking superpotential.

sources.title: Bubbles of Nothing in Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Review Witten's bubble by double Wick rotation of five-dimensional Schwarzschild geometry. Smooth closure of the circle fixes its coordinate periodicity, and the resulting tip contains a dS₃ bubble worldvolume and a cigar-shaped transverse disk.

sources.title: Decay of flux vacua to nothing

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction over the magnetized S² produces a four-dimensional canonical radion ψ and effective potential. Its extrema distinguish stable compactifications from unstable branches that can roll toward another extremum or decompactification.

sources.title: Supersymmetric AdS vacua and separation of scales

evidence.text: Perturbative ODE expansions near the poles and equator establish limiting warp-function behaviour. Numerical solutions sample initial conditions and explore the extent of the equatorial region with order-one scale ratios.

sources.title: Slow-Roll Inflation in Non-geometric Flux Compactification

evidence.text: Integer flux configurations satisfying R-R tadpole, T-dual tadpole and Q·H3=Q·Q=0 Bianchi constraints are generated before numerical minimisation. A genetic algorithm searches the six real moduli with stated convergence criterion 10^-20 and a finite flux cutoff.

sources.title: More stable de Sitter vacua from S-dual nongeometric fluxes

evidence.text: The displayed superpotential is W=P₀−SP₁+Σm(P₂m−SP₃m)Um, with cubic polynomials in the complex-structure fields and coefficients determined by fluxes. The Kähler potential is K=−Σi=1⁷ln(2ψi). Numerical mass matrices, F-terms and gravitino quantities characterize the candidates.

destinations.title: How do modulus and KK scales behave in a type IIA AdS flux family with a dilute-flux limit?

Are the known non-supersymmetric sisters of supersymmetric type-IIA AdS7 vacua perturbatively or nonperturbatively unstable, and can these families exhibit separation between AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales?

Do non-supersymmetric AdS vacua of dyonic ISO(7) maximal supergravity that are perturbatively stable within D = 4 develop brane-jet instabilities after uplift to massive IIA, or decay through domain walls?
Can WGC compatibility select a vacuum among trial geometries whose deformations have KK-scale masses? The appendix tests the idea through toric AdS5 compactifications and wrapped D3 particles.
Do purely nonperturbative AdS vacua with W0 = 0 meet the axionic WGC and AdS-moduli conjecture, and can their spectator Kähler moduli be stabilized?

Can nongeometric type IIB compactifications without Kähler moduli provide fully stabilized Minkowski, AdS and dS solutions, and broaden tests of swampland conjectures beyond geometric supergravity constructions?

Can the perturbatively stable non-supersymmetric DGKT-like branches be described with localised sources in ten dimensions, and do wrapped-brane membranes supply non-perturbative instabilities consistent with the membrane WGC and its sharpening?

Can generalized calibrations protect non-supersymmetric type-II AdS vacua against D-brane bubble decay, including abelian bound states, and establish classical stability of D-branes already present in a background?

Can dynamical open-string scalars and non-Abelian fluxes generate additional supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS7 vacua, and what do interpolating domain walls imply about stability within the retained fields?
